title: Laying Out the Header with CSS

blocks.content: Laying Out the Header with CSS
In the last lesson, you built the header structure in HTML. Everything is in place, but it looks stacked and plain because the browser is applying its default styles.
Now we'll start shaping the layout with CSS. The goal here is simple:

items: place the items on a single horizontal row
match the overall header layout from the Figma design

blocks.content: You're not polishing yet. You're getting the layout right so the rest of the styling work feels easy instead of fragile.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
